### The Goal
I wanted to see if we could quantify the emotional highs and lows across different books of the Bible. I am especially interested in the sentiment between the Old and New Testament. I have experience with sentiment analysis in R but will try to do this in Python using  Natural Language Processing (NLTK) and pandas.
